_comment: Catalog product name (must match the Pricing Sheet exactly) -> Shopify variant GID. PSA Bumper Case and Single Matte Sleeves have multiple color variants at the same price with no color tracked in the catalog; each defaults to its first-listed color (Blue, Black respectively). Line item price is always overridden with the catalog's tier-computed price, never the Shopify variant's own price, so any drift between the two doesn't matter.
